description: Resolve a free-text place name ("toronto", "Japan", "Texas") to the location identifiers search_jobs accepts (country-XX, state-XX-YY, city-XX-YY-name). Searches every place JobYap knows, not only those with current openings, so an identifier may match no jobs. City display omits the state, and the list can be shorter than limit.
name: search_locations
title: Search locations
